title: Baby Thomas Gerald Outdoors on Lawn, 1930s B&W Elko Snapshot Photo
description: An intimate black-and-white snapshot capturing an eight-month-old infant identified on the reverse as Thomas Gerald. The baby is dressed in a light-colored outfit, seated outside on a blanket over the lawn in front of leafy shrubbery, intently focused on an object in his hands. The print features a distinctive ornate geometric decorative border with 'ELKO' printed in each corner, a hallmark of American commercial photo finishing in the late 1920s to 1930s.
